item.title: A Sustainable Fully Fluorine‐Free Interfacial Chemistry for Reversible Anode‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a fully fluorine-free interfacial strategy combining a cross-linked VC-MBA artificial SEI on Cu with a fluorine-free electrolyte, avoiding fluorinated SEI-formers and alloy interlayers. This enables homogeneous Li deposition and an inorganic-rich (Li2O, Li3N) SEI, improving reversibility. Significance: demonstrates sustainable anode-free Li metal batteries, with LFP cells retaining 84.5% over 350 cycles and NCM811 86.6% over 100 cycles.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Novelty: A non-destructive framework using the quasi-static component of nonlinear ultrasonic guided waves, with an operando electro-acoustic-thermal platform that statistically isolates temperature artefacts from intrinsic signals. Significance: Enables simultaneous, precise prediction of SOC and SOCN across −10°C to 40°C, maps ultrasonic signatures to temperature-dependent mechanics and irreversible capacity fade, and offers a scalable diagnostic tool for batteries in extreme environments.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining in-situ conversion of Li₂CO₃ to a Li₂PO₃F interfacial layer with EDTA-induced PVDF α→β phase transition, creating a self-healing solid electrolyte with fast ion transport and stable interfaces. Its significance is enabling high-performance LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂||Li batteries, plus a non-destructive differential monitoring method for tracking electrochemical-mechanical-thermal responses.
🏷 composite solid electrolyte · self-healing polymer · LLZTO interface · PVDF beta phase · lithium metal battery

item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that supposedly inert aluminum current collectors undergo intense exothermic reactions with cathodes above 600°C, catalyzed by fluorides and resembling rocket propellant combustion. This overlooked heat source rivals electrolyte contribution. Significance: fluorine-free electrolytes plus flame retardants suppress this reaction, cutting peak pouch-cell temperatures below 400°C, offering new thermal-safety design strategies.
🏷 thermal runaway · aluminum current collector · battery safety · fluoride catalysis · fluorine-free electrolyte

item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in anion regulation using OTf⁻/Ac⁻ hybrid electrolyte to form fluoride-rich SEI at the anode and induce defect-rich MnO₂ via instantaneous nucleation at the cathode. This dual regulation enables stable dual electrode-free Zn-MnO₂ batteries with 7500+ cycles, addressing dead manganese accumulation and interfacial irreversibility—a transformative strategy for high-energy aqueous batteries.
🏷 Zn-MnO2 battery · anion regulation · fluoride-rich SEI · Ruetschi defects · electrode-free battery

item.title: Stress‐Regulated Li Plating in Hybrid Ag–Carbon/Carbon Nanofiber Anodes for Durable All‐Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in identifying stress accumulation from repetitive Li plating/stripping as a key degradation cause in all-solid-state batteries, and designing a mechanically adaptive Ag–carbon/CNF hybrid anode that combines Ag–Li alloying for uniform nucleation with a porous CNF framework for stress dissipation. This enables stable cycling over 250 cycles at high loading and pouch-cell operation at practical pressures, advancing durable high-energy-density ASSBs.
🏷 all-solid-state battery · Ag-carbon nanofiber anode · Li plating stress · mechanical buffering · phase-field modeling
